annotation_membership_vs_sufficient_rela.new_actual_inspection: Inspect the complete document for four distinct operative controls. Agreement confidentiality covers the agreement or its existence or terms, or the existence, content, status, or terms of discussions or negotiations. A direct sentence deeming those subjects confidential is complete responsive evidence by itself; when coverage instead depends on a protected-information definition plus a general secrecy duty, retain both, while ordinary transaction references remain insufficient. Compelled-disclosure notice requires legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, court, or administrative compulsion to trigger notice, information, or consultation to the disclosing party; preserve timing, legal-permission qualifications, and protective-order mechanisms. Unauthorized-use notice or bare permission to disclose is not enough. Under the supplied corpus supervision, solicitation evidence includes operative personnel hiring or solicitation restrictions and independently operative proxy or vote-solicitation standstill provisions. Preserve their governing lead-ins, target classes, duration, consent conditions, exceptions, and independently repeated responsive items; headings, definitions, exceptions, and incidental uses of the word solicitation do not suffice. Reverse engineering requires an operative prohibition on reverse engineering, decompiling, or disassembling protected material; general secrecy, copying, product-use, or intellectual-property language is not equivalent. No located clause is never proof of whole-document absence.
